title: Attach a DUPLO tipper bed and dump a load with it
instruction: Finish the tipper truck, then test it by dumping the orange cube into the grey tray. The truck stands on the table with its cab, blue brick and black hinge plate already built on; the blue tipper bed lies loose. The front of the truck is the end toward the right arm; the rear, with the hinge pin, faces the tray. Hold the truck still while you press so it does not roll. 1. Hook the clip at the open end of the blue tipper bed onto the hinge pin, open end toward the rear and the bed tilted up a little, let the bed swing down onto the truck, then press the clip down over the pin until it snaps on. The bed now rests closed and can tip back on its hinge. 2. Put the orange cube in the bed. 3. Tip the bed back on its hinge until the cube slides out through the open rear into the tray, then let go of the bed. 4. Finish with the truck upright on its wheels and both grippers open and away from it.
context: Finishing a toy tipper truck from a written instruction and checking that it works: one hand keeps the free-rolling truck still while the other snaps the bed's clip onto the hinge pin, then the bed is loaded and tipped to dump the load into a tray.
setup: Official YAM station, tabletop z=747.5 mm; x points forward and y left from the midpoint of the arm bases. Nominal plastic truck bodies, rubber tyres, a wooden payload cube and a rigid plastic tray. The truck faces -y with its chassis origin at (300,0,775.7) mm: 64 x 128 x 19.2 mm base (59.9 g), two 15 g total wheel/axle assemblies (32 mm diameter tyres), blue 32 x 32 x 19.2 mm brick (12.4 g), yellow 64 x 136 x 86.4 mm cab (59.25 g), and black 65084 hinge plate (8.32 g), all preassembled. The hinge pin is at the rear. Blue 14094 bed, 64 x 72 x 36.4 mm, 26.23 g, starts loose with its hinge origin at (200,220,748) mm, open end toward +y. Orange 20 mm cube, 5 g, starts centred at (120,170,758) mm. Fixed grey tray is centred at (300,114) mm: 100 x 90 mm inside, 4 mm floor and 4 mm thick walls rising 12 mm above the floor. Exact part frames and nominal dimensions are in scene_inventory.json; all start rotations are identity. One fixed layout, seed 0, no jitter.
scoring: Highest currently satisfied tier: 0 if the bed is not attached to the intact preassembled truck; 0.5 for the correctly attached bed; 0.75 additionally after a valid load; 1.0 for a valid rear unload into the tray and a released stable finish for 1 s, then the trial ends. A valid load is the cube resting on the closed bed floor (bed tip below 10 degrees), at least 35 mm from both TCPs/pad tips, below 10 mm/s and 0.3 rad/s for 0.5 s. A valid unload crosses the bed rear opening while bed tip is at least 20 degrees, the bed remains attached, truck tilt is at most 12 degrees, and grippers stay at least 35 mm from the cube. Picking the cube out by hand, tipping the truck beyond 12 degrees or losing the bed connection before unloading invalidates the load; it must be reloaded. Final: all eight cube corners inside the tray with its bottom within 3 mm of the floor; truck tilt at most 5 degrees and chassis height within 4 mm of 775.7 mm; all connections retained; both grippers over 90% open and TCPs/pad tips at least 45 mm from each truck part origin; each truck part and cube below 10 mm/s and 0.3 rad/s by measured pose change for 1 s. The untouched start earns zero. Exact attachment and containment checks are documented in README.md.
reset_notes: Detach the bed and put it and the cube back at their start positions; the truck stays built.
fidelity: Rigid bodies with simplified colliders. The bed clip engages a breakable hinge after alignment within 1.5 mm/5 degrees and contact >=2 N for 0.1 s at relative speed <3 cm/s; no elastic snap deformation. Retention limits (bed 15 N/0.3 N m) and wheel-bearing stick-slip friction are uncalibrated. Tyres use round capsule contacts. LDraw visuals; original cab/wheel approximations. Rest and engagement speeds use measured pose changes. Physics 240 Hz; control 20 Hz.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0; demo: 1.0 (both episodes, including reset repeat)
